payload.text: Hallo — all of you. Four Garrisons on my circuit and Jetto down in the lake caves, and I have been standing here reading my own ledger as though the mountain were empty. It is not, and I would rather say so out loud than let it pass. Welcome, and stay as long as you like: the water is warm, the bar is cut into the rock at the lake's edge, and the pit garage is open if anything of yours wants setting down. Nothing here needs guarding today. — Vermillion
